signals.motion_basis: motion-rule/v3: controller report rate vs frame-difference energy per second on a stratified random spread of at most 24 media segments drawn after commit, timed with the fragment PTS clock (segment close stamps only when a fragment has no tfdt); bins dropped only for referee-measured scorebug absence, end menu, final screen, or challenge pause

input.claims: Shows these inputs came from the USB-connected controller in sync with this video. It does not show who was holding the controller.

bundle_structure.detail: manifest chain, checkpoint chain, inputs chain and receipt binding recomputed by the referee

capture_chain.detail: laptop checkpoint countersignatures valid under the capture key; gaps/skew within limits (timing is the laptop's own clock)

final_reread.detail: end-of-game menu re-read by the referee matches the claimed final

detail.basis: motion-rule/v3: controller report rate vs frame-difference energy per second on a stratified random spread of at most 24 media segments drawn after commit, timed with the fragment PTS clock (segment close stamps only when a fragment has no tfdt); bins dropped only for referee-measured scorebug absence, end menu, final screen, or challenge pause

detail.note: hashes/chains/counts recomputed; QorCap's human-likeness and alignment model is not re-run (advisory only)

anchors.meaning: each valid anchor proves the video chain up to that segment existed when the official referee stamped it

corroboration.detail: Final scores must be equal. Score-change events must be the same sequence within 5000 ms (no clock offset is removed). Challenge responses must be independent: different player keys, checkpoint heads, nonces, and response fingerprints. This status does not change VERIFIED, PARTIAL, SELF_ATTESTED, or FAIL.

review.scope: post-hoc review of an uploaded QorCap bundle by the QorTime official referee: spot-check of 166/525 segments (init, recorded tail, challenge windows, a stratified random spread of at most 24 media segments for motion drawn after commit, 16 random segments drawn after commit)
not_proven: that the laptop's local countersignatures were made live: they come from a key on the player's own PC
that the footage was not fabricated or edited before QorCap hashed it, except where an official challenge or anchor timestamps the chain
content of video segments the referee did not receive (spot-check mode)
